title: Folgore
sources:
- [Maserati US — GranTurismo Folgore](https://www.maserati.com/us/en/models/granturismo/granturismo-folgore)
- [Cars.com — 2025 GranTurismo Folgore](https://www.cars.com/research/maserati-granturismo_folgore-2025/)
- [InsideEVs — EPA range](https://insideevs.com/news/724923/maserati-granturismo-folgore-epa-range/)
- [EV Database — GranTurismo Folgore](https://ev-database.org/car/1803/Maserati-GranTurismo-Folgore)
- [Consumer Reports — 2025 Grecale reliability (brand inference)](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/maserati/grecale/2025/reliability/)
infotainment: Dual touchscreen MIA 2.0 system — 12.3-inch upper + 8.8-inch lower comfort display, plus 12.3-inch digital cluster and 12.2-inch HUD. Runs Android Automotive-derived stack.
adasStandard: Maserati Intelligent Assistant ADAS package: adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, lane-keep assist, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, traffic sign recognition, driver-attention monitoring camera, 360-degree surround-view camera ([Maserati US — GranTurismo Folgore](https://www.maserati.com/us/en/models/granturismo/granturismo-folgore), [Cars.com](https://www.cars.com/research/maserati-granturismo_folgore-2025/)).
adasOptional: Highway Assist (Level 2 hands-on lane-centering + adaptive cruise) bundled into the top-tier Folgore configuration; no Level 3 hands-off system offered. Night vision is not available.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard. High-resolution backup camera with dynamic guidelines and selectable wide-angle / top-down views as part of the 360 surround system. No factory rear-camera-mirror option.
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360-degree surround-view camera system; no Honda-LaneWatch-style dedicated side-view camera; no trailer view (vehicle is not rated for towing).
subscriptionFeatures: Maserati Connect (remote functions, OTA, geofencing, stolen-vehicle): trial included 5 years, renewal in the low hundreds USD/year per Ubigi pricing ([Ubigi for Maserati](https://maserati.ubigi.com/assistance/)). No hardware-installed-but-software-locked features (heated seats, performance, range) have been documented for the GranTurismo Folgore; equipment is mechanical / config-time only. Tesla Supercharger access enabled via $230 Stellantis-approved NACS-to-CCS1 adapter from Mopar.com (one-time hardware purchase, not a subscription).
drmNotes: Car remains fully drivable without an active cellular connection. Maserati Connect subscription gates remote control (lock/unlock/climate/locate via app), stolen-vehicle assistance, and OTA map/software updates. Initial Connect trial included for 5 years on Folgore models; renewal pricing not publicly fixed. Core ADAS, propulsion, charging, infotainment (CarPlay/AA), and navigation operate locally without Connect.
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving interlock as of MY2025 (the IIJA Section 24220 mandate is not yet in force and Stellantis has made no Maserati-brand specific commitment). The car ships with a driver-attention camera that monitors gaze/eyelid for distraction/drowsiness and issues a chime — software-only, no mechanical immobilization, no breathalyzer hardware.
knownIssues: Folgore lineup is too new and too low-volume for a meaningful field-issue dataset. Consumer Reports projects Maserati brand reliability as below the new-vehicle average and the Grecale Folgore as 'less reliable than other new cars' — expectation likely carries to GranTurismo Folgore by brand inference ([Consumer Reports](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/maserati/grecale/2025/reliability/)). Reported software gripes on MTC infotainment (occasional reboots, lag) on early Folgore deliveries.
recalls: Data unavailable: NHTSA recall search for 2025 GranTurismo Folgore returns no campaigns specific to the Folgore as of 2026-05; the broader Maserati GranTurismo nameplate has a handful of platform-shared recalls (electrical, software). Verify on https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls before purchase.
stateIncentives: Federal IRC 30D credit not applicable — Folgore is built in Modena, Italy (fails final-assembly-in-North-America). Beyond federal, MY2025 purchasers may qualify for state-level EV incentives (e.g., NJ sales-tax exemption was eliminated 2024; CO state EV credit phased to $1,500 cap for vehicles >$80k MSRP; most luxury-EV state programs cap MSRP below the $192k Folgore base). Practically no meaningful incentive available.

title: Grecale
sources:

warrantyBattery: Data unavailable: Maserati does not publish a separate hybrid-battery warranty for the 48V MHEV starter battery; coverage falls under the standard 4yr/50k bumper-to-bumper.
infotainment: MIA 2.0 dual touchscreen (12.3 + 8.8 inch) + 12.3-inch digital cluster.
adasStandard: Maserati Intelligent Assistant: ACC, lane-keep assist, blind-spot monitor, rear cross-traffic, AEB with pedestrian detection, traffic sign recognition, driver-attention camera, rearview camera ([Maserati US — Grecale](https://www.maserati.com/us/en/models/grecale), [US News](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/maserati/grecale)).
adasOptional: Highway Assist (Level 2 hands-on lane-centering), 360 surround-view, head-up display in option packages.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard backup camera with dynamic guidelines. 360 surround-view optional.
sideViewCameraNotes: Optional 360 surround-view; no dedicated LaneWatch-style side camera; no trailer view.
subscriptionFeatures: Maserati Connect (shorter trial than Folgore, then paid renewal). No hardware-installed-but-software-locked features documented for Grecale MHEV.
drmNotes: Fully drivable without cellular; Maserati Connect subscription gates app remote functions, OTA updates, stolen-vehicle services. MHEV trims include Connect trial (typically 1-3 years on non-Folgore Maseratis; Folgore-tier 5-yr trial does not extend to MHEV).
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving interlock as of MY2025. Driver-attention camera (software) only.

recalls: Data unavailable: NHTSA lists a small handful of platform-wide Grecale recalls (electrical, brake, software) across MY23-MY25; verify 2025-specific campaigns at https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls.
stateIncentives: 30D federal credit only applies to PHEVs/BEVs; the 2.0L MHEV does not qualify (no plug-in capability, insufficient battery kWh). No state EV incentive applies to a 48V mild hybrid.
